title: Kicked Crunchy Ukrainian Chicken Wrap
description: A nutty and light Ukrainian dish featuring lemongrass and takrai, wrapped in a ti leaf, this crowd-pleaser is perfect for any occasion, with an anti-inflammatory twist.
instructions: Pound the chicken breast to an even thickness and cut into strips.
In a blender, combine lemongrass, takrai, and a pinch of salt, and blend until well combined.
In a shallow dish, mix together flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of black pepper.
Dip each chicken strip into the flour mixture, then the egg, and finally the flour mixture again, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 350 degrees.
Double-fry the chicken strips, first frying for 2-3 minutes on each side, then increasing the heat and frying for an additional 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the chicken strips on paper towels and season with salt and black pepper.
To assemble the wraps, place a few pieces of the fried chicken onto a ti leaf, add a sprinkle of the lemongrass-takrai mixture, and serve immediately.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
